title: Unified cutover schedule and content governance for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce a single cutover schedule, a content ownership matrix for release notes and GTM artifacts, and a handoff checklist that ensures API, Console, and Runtime teams ship in a coordinated window with clear rollback criteria. This ticket covers cross-team sequencing, content signoffs, and the communications playbook for the release train.
background: Past releases have had fragmented cut criteria across teams (API owned latency SLOs, Console owned UX flags, Runtime owned kernel rollouts). That produced last-minute scope trims and inconsistent release notes. We need an enforceable, minimal 'cut checklist' plus a mapped set of content owners for every public deliverable (docs, console banners, changelog, release notes, tweet/announcement).
acceptance_criteria: 1) A single cutover calendar published and accepted by eng/product/design. 2) Ownership matrix mapping each consumer-facing artifact to an owner with signoff instructions. 3) A cut checklist that includes metrics gates and rollback triggers. 4) Release notes draft created with owners and review timeline. 5) Postmortem template prepared for any post-release regressions.
progress_updates:
2025-02-12: Kickoff with API, Console, Runtime; agreed to central calendar and weekly triage. - Aisha
2025-02-20: Draft cut criteria circulated; Runtime requested clarifications on kernel rollout gating. - Marco
2025-02-24: Design submitted console banner copy and screenshot variants (link below).
decisions: 1) Use central calendar (Google Calendar shared) as canonical schedule. 2) 'Soft freeze' 5 business days before cut for docs and marketing; 'hard freeze' 48 hours before for deploy-affecting PRs. 3) Rollback triggers: >2% error-rate delta for 10 minutes OR median latency regression >30% relative to baseline for 5 minutes. 4) Release notes owner: PM (Aisha) compiles; docs (Samira Chen) performs technical accuracy review; eng owners must provide bullet points by D-3.
review_feedback: Engineering: request automated smoke-checks for KV cache and batcher after deploy (ENG-5214). Design: prefer in-console changelog entry over banner for smaller items (DES-732). Go-to-market: ask for a single one-pager summarizing customer impact for account executives. Legal: no additional restrictions but flagged a KMS mention that needs privacy review.
next_steps: 1) Finalize ownership matrix by 2025-03-05. 2) Publish cut checklist in Confluence and add to central calendar. 3) Run tabletop for rollback scenario with SRE on 2025-03-12. 4) Collect release note bullets from eng by 2025-03-19.
rollout_plan: Staged rollout: Canary (5% traffic) -> Ramp to 25% after 2 hours if no gate breaches -> Ramp to 100% over 24h. Canary runs in region-us-east-1 then region-eu-west-1. If any rollback trigger fires, immediate failover to previous model variant and pause further ramps. Branch protection: no force pushes to release branch after D-1 unless approved by Release Manager.
communications_plan: - Day T-7: Internal: Send schedule + ownership matrix to all stakeholders. - Day T-3: Engineers provide release-note bullets. - Day T: Release channel 'release-train' live updates; Product sends public release notes and marketing one-pager. - Post-release: 72-hour status update to customers if any incidents occurred.
handoff_checklist: 1) All release-note bullets compiled and reviewed. 2) Docs PR merged and published on staging. 3) Console banner/changelog entry approved by Design. 4) SLIs baseline captured and smoke tests green. 5) Rollback playbook validated with SRE. 6) GTM assets (one-pager + blog draft) ready and scheduled.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Kernel changes in Runtime may increase tail latency. Mitigation: keep model/quantized fallback available and ensure automated canary comparators. Risk: Docs lagging behind last-minute API surface changes. Mitigation: require API owners to publish deprecation/behavior notes by D-3.
owner_notes: Please add any missing artifacts to the Confluence page above. If you cannot meet the D-3 deliverable for release notes, flag here and assign a delegate. Expect an all-hands triage call on 2025-03-20 to finalize scoping.
post_release_expectations: Collect telemetry for 72 hours: error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost per request. Product to run a quality check against 10 canonical prompts and report any semantic regressions. Post-release review meeting scheduled for 2025-04-04.
audit_trail: 2025-02-12 Kickoff note created by Aisha. 2025-02-20 Draft cut criteria posted (link). 2025-02-24 Design assets uploaded. 2025-02-28 Engineering smoke-check plan added (ENG-5214).
